title: Observation
description: A recorded discovery made during signal exploration or ML diagnostics, living at intracardiac-platform/project/phases/phase_X/observations/<id>.json. Schema version 1. The free-text `description` is REQUIRED — the discovery IS the observation; a pure trace list with no prose is data without context. `traces` (pinned traces of interest) and `view_state` (egm-studio reload state) are OPTIONAL. Bank references are DERIVED (by validate_manifest) from the union of view_state.banks_loaded and traces[].bank, never declared separately, so they can't go out of sync. The observation does not declare which phase it belongs to — that membership is recorded by the phase manifest that points at it. See cross_artifact_linkage_design.md section 4.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Consumers MUST refuse unknown major versions.

description.description: REQUIRED free-text prose — the 'what I noticed'. The whole point of an observation; lets someone returning cold understand the finding and decide whether it still matters.

references.description: Structured references to OTHER artifact types (models, parent observations). Bank refs are intentionally absent here — they are derived from view_state.banks_loaded + traces[].bank.

models.description: Models this observation is about, if any.

observations.description: Parent observations this one builds on, if any.

traces.description: OPTIONAL pinned traces of interest. Becomes the data source for downstream trace-gallery figures that reference this observation.

view_state.description: OPTIONAL egm-studio reload state — what to load to recreate the view that produced this observation. egm-studio owns the exact shape; additional keys are allowed for forward compatibility.

banks_loaded.description: Bank IDs loaded in the view.

selected_trace_indices_within_filter.description: Indices selected within the filtered/sorted view.

TraceRef.title: TraceRef
TraceRef.description: Reference to one trace inside a bank. v0.1 trace addressing is (bank id, integer index); stable per-trace IDs are a deferred upgrade.

bank.description: Stable id of the bank the trace lives in.

index.description: Integer index of the trace within the bank (v0.1 trace ID).
